description: UI-driven API key configuration: Remove startup barriers, fix frontend-backend API contract mismatch for key updates, make settings button more prominent with 'Configuracion IA' label.
steps: Change backend settings.py: default debug=True, only enforce secret key validation when PRODUCTION=true env var is set
Add batch config endpoint to backend ai.py that accepts {keys: {provider: key, ...}} matching frontend contract
Update App.tsx header to show 'Configuracion IA' button/label prominently
Update Settings.tsx header title to reflect IA configuration focus
acceptance_criteria: Backend starts without any .env or environment variables (DEBUG defaults to true)
Security validation only triggers when PRODUCTION=true is explicitly set
Frontend can save multiple API keys in one request via PUT /api/ai/config
Settings button in header shows 'Configuracion IA' text
findings: The fs_write and str_replace tools did not persist to disk in this environment. Used python3 pathlib to write files instead. All 210 backend tests and 25 frontend tests pass.
